# bcm_cmpart_partitions (Data Source)

Fetches partition information from BCM CMPart service. Partitions define filesystem configurations referenced by software images via bootfs_part and fs_part UUID fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve all partitions from BCM cluster
data "bcm_cmpart_partitions" "all" {}

# Filter partitions by name pattern (case-insensitive)
data "bcm_cmpart_partitions" "base_partitions" {
  filter {
    name_pattern = "base"
  }
}

# Example: Use partition UUID in software image resource
# resource "bcm_cmpart_softwareimage" "example" {
#   name       = "my-custom-image"
#   path       = "/cm/images/my-custom-image"
#   bootfspart = data.bcm_cmpart_partitions.base_partitions.partitions[0].uuid
#   # ... other configuration
# }

# Output partition information
output "all_partition_names" {
  description = "Names of all partitions in the cluster"
  value       = [for p in data.bcm_cmpart_partitions.all.partitions : p.name]
}

output "base_partition_uuid" {
  description = "UUID of the first partition matching 'base'"
  value       = length(data.bcm_cmpart_partitions.base_partitions.partitions) > 0 ? data.bcm_cmpart_partitions.base_partitions.partitions[0].uuid : null
}

output "partition_details" {
  description = "Detailed information about all partitions"
  value = {
    for p in data.bcm_cmpart_partitions.all.partitions : p.name => {
      uuid         = p.uuid
      cluster_name = p.cluster_name
      slave_name   = p.slave_name
      time_servers = p.time_servers
      name_servers = p.name_servers
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block, Optional) Client-side filtering criteria for partitions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for this data source
- `partitions` (Attributes List) List of partitions retrieved from BCM cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--partitions))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `name_pattern` (String) Case-insensitive substring match for partition name (e.g., base matches base-partition)


<a id="nestedatt--partitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `partitions`

Read-Only:

- `admin_email` (List of String) Administrator email addresses
- `base_type` (String) BCM entity base type (typically Partition)
- `child_type` (String) BCM polymorphic type discriminator
- `cluster_name` (String) Display name for the cluster
- `creation_time` (Number) Unix timestamp of partition creation
- `id` (String) Partition identifier (same as uuid)
- `modified` (Boolean) Whether partition has uncommitted modifications
- `name` (String) Human-readable partition name
- `name_servers` (List of String) DNS name server addresses
- `no_zero_conf` (Boolean) Disable Zeroconf networking
- `notes` (String) User notes or description
- `relay_host` (String) SMTP relay hostname for email notifications
- `revision` (String) BCM revision tracking field
- `search_domains` (List of String) DNS search domains
- `slave_digits` (Number) Number of digits in node numbering (e.g., 3 for node001)
- `slave_name` (String) Node naming prefix (e.g., node for node001, node002)
- `time_servers` (List of String) NTP time server addresses
- `to_be_removed` (Boolean) Whether partition is marked for deletion
- `uuid` (String) Partition UUID (primary identifier)
